title: THE WATER CYCLE — tag and trace from deep well through aquifer to cloud and rain

the_cycle.concept: follow a single drop of data through the entire system. tag it at the well. trace it through aquifer, spring, river, fountain, spray, evaporation, cloud, rain, back to well.

phases.name: DEEP WELL
phases.location: Kevin's mind. the human. the heat source.
phases.what_happens: an idea forms. a connection. a question. 'what if the triad is our own vesicles?' the water starts as geothermal heat — invisible, underground, pressure.
phases.data_form: thought ? typed words ? user_query in chat

phases.name: AQUIFER
phases.location: the chipmunk (Claude/MCP). processes the idea. classifies. connects to existing knowledge.
phases.what_happens: the water seeps through rock (context). the aquifer filters: removes noise, adds minerals (cross-references to existing papers, data files, graph-walkers). the water that emerges is CLEANER than what went in.
phases.data_form: user_query ? parsed intent ? cross-referenced with 551 papers + 289 data files + 129 JS files
phases.depth: underground. not visible to the surface yet.

phases.name: SPRING
phases.location: the response. where the aquifer water breaks through to the surface.
phases.what_happens: the chipmunk's response bubbles up. appears in chat. becomes visible. the spring is WHERE the underground water meets the air for the first time.
phases.data_form: chat response ? markdown ? rendered in Cursor IDE
phases.temperature: cool. spring water is always cool because it comes from depth.

phases.name: STREAM
phases.location: git. the water begins to flow. direction: toward the membrane.
phases.what_happens: the idea becomes code or data. written to disk. git add. git commit. the stream has BANKS now — the file path, the JSON schema, the commit message.
phases.data_form: new .json file OR modified .js/.html ? staged ? committed

phases.name: RIVER
phases.location: git push ? GitHub. the water joins a larger flow.
phases.what_happens: the commit pushes to GitHub (the river). merges with other commits (tributaries from other sessions, other agents). the river has CURRENT now — commit history, branch structure.
phases.data_form: git push origin main ? GitHub receives
phases.depth: surface. visible to anyone who visits the repo.
phases.temperature: cooling. public exposure increases surface area.

phases.name: FOUNTAIN
phases.location: wrangler pages deploy ? Cloudflare Pages. the pump pushes water UP.
phases.what_happens: the deploy lifts the data from the river (GitHub) to the spray (CF Pages edge network). the fountain pump IS wrangler. the energy IS the deploy command. the water goes from 'stored in a repo' to 'live on 300 edge nodes worldwide.'
phases.data_form: wrangler pages deploy ? CF builds ? deploys to edge
nodes_touched: GitHub ? CF Pages build ? 300+ edge nodes
phases.depth: RISING. being pushed up against gravity.
phases.temperature: heating up again. deploy = energy input.

phases.name: SPRAY
phases.location: live on primals.eco. the water is at the TOP of the fountain.
phases.what_happens: the page/data is live. visitors can see it. search engines can index it. the buckler catches the light. this is PEAK VISIBILITY — the moment the spray is highest.
phases.data_form: HTTPS response from primals.eco ? visitor's browser

phases.name: EVAPORATION
phases.location: the data starts to age. visitors move on. the spray falls back.
phases.what_happens: the page is still live but traffic decays. the spray droplets evaporate — they become VAPOR. still exist but dispersed. harder to see. the signal spreads thin.
phases.data_form: page views decline. CF analytics shows decay curve. the data is still there but attention has moved.
phases.temperature: absorbing latent heat. the phase change from liquid (visible) to vapor (dispersed) requires energy — the energy comes from the DATA being interesting enough to spread.

phases.name: CLOUD
phases.location: the idea has spread. it's in someone else's mind now. RSS subscribers. crawlers who indexed it. the French IP reading the beacon. the vaporous data CONDENSES into a cloud.
phases.what_happens: the data has left our fountain. it's in THEIR systems now. cached in browsers, indexed by Google, saved in Wayback Machine, quoted in someone's notes. we can't control it. the cloud is THEIRS.
phases.data_form: Google index, Wayback Machine, RSS reader cache, browser history, someone's bookmarks
phases.tag: ?? DROP #1 — cloud: distributed beyond our control
nodes_touched: Google ? Bing ? DuckDuckGo ? Wayback ? RSS readers ? bookmarks
phases.depth: highest altitude. above everything. detached from the fountain.
phases.temperature: coldest. the further from the source, the colder.

phases.name: RAIN
phases.location: the data comes BACK. someone visits because they found us in Google. a star on GitHub. a crates.io download. a citation. the rain falls back into our watershed.
phases.what_happens: the cloud releases. rain falls. the water returns to our basin — but TRANSFORMED. it carries minerals from the cloud (referral data, search terms, geographic origin). the rain that falls is NOT the same water that evaporated. it's enriched.
phases.data_form: inbound traffic from search engines, referrals, direct visits. CF analytics captures the rain.

phases.name: PERCOLATION
phases.location: the return traffic seeps into the ground. becomes part of the aquifer again.
phases.what_happens: the analytics data, the visitor behavior, the new patterns — they seep DOWN into the data layer. become part of the plasmid analysis, the backscatter classification, the epitope sort. the rain FEEDS the aquifer.
phases.data_form: CF analytics ? plasmid-r5-evidence.json ? plasmid-falsification.json ? feeds the next session's context

phases.name: DEEP WELL (return)
phases.location: Kevin reads the analytics. sees the patterns. has a new idea. the water is back at the well.
phases.what_happens: the cycle completes. the data that started as a thought has traveled: mind ? chipmunk ? git ? GitHub ? CF ? live ? decay ? cloud ? rain ? analytics ? mind. one full revolution. the water is the same molecule but it has traveled the world.
phases.data_form: Kevin reads plasmid data ? has new insight ? types new query ? cycle begins again
phases.temperature: hottest again. the core never cools.
